CONTENT_LIBRARY_DESC: Everything as Content means articles, pages, taxonomies, and templates all live in one canonical content plane.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_EMPTY_INITIAL_DESC: Everything here can become a page, post, block, or template.
CONTENT_LIBRARY_EMPTY_FILTERED_DESC: Try another view, clear filters, or broaden your search.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_DESC: Create the draft first, then give it an initial working shape through starter presets and explicit capability packs.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_SIDE_DESC: This surface sits between the library and the editor. It exists to make the draft real first, then make the starting shape legible before authoring begins.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRINCIPLE_ONE: Every content item begins as formless clay, not as a locked type.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRINCIPLE_TWO: Presets are familiar starting points. Capability packs remain the real structure.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRINCIPLE_THREE: You can keep shaping after this step. Nothing here hard-locks the draft.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_ONE_TITLE: Create the draft before deciding what it becomes
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_ONE_DESC: Keep this intentionally light. Give the draft a working title, keep the locale sane, and let the content exist before you classify it.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_ONE_SUPPORT: Once the draft exists, the next step shapes it without forcing a model-first form.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_ONE_ASIDE_DESC: If the system waits until after shape selection to create the object, the flow collapses back into type-first creation.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_ONE_ASIDE_POINT_O: The draft becomes a real content item immediately.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_ONE_ASIDE_POINT_T: No model is required up front.
The next step can focus on shape instead of record insertion.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_TWO_TITLE: Choose a starter preset, then refine the capability packs
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_STEP_TWO_DESC: Preset shapes help you recognize a useful starting point. Capability packs express the real responsibilities this content should take on.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_FIELD_TITLE_DESC: Use the lightest title that helps you recognize the draft. You can refine it later in the editor.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_FIELD_TITLE_PLACEHOLDE: Homepage hero, release note draft, spring taxonomy...
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_FIELD_LOCALE_DESC: Keep the draft aligned with the locale you expect to author first.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_FOOTER_READY_TITLE: The draft is real. Now lock in the starting shape you want to carry forward.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_FOOTER_READY_DESC: Selecting a preset activates its recommended packs. You can still add or remove packs before entering the editor.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_DRAFT_SUMMARY_DESC: This draft now exists in {{locale}}. The next step only shapes it.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESETS_DESC: Pick a familiar starting point when it helps. Leave it blank when you want to compose shape from capability packs alone.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_PAGE_DESC: Start from a route-aware page that wants publishing support, layout binding, and SEO control.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_PAGE_USE_CASE: it should resolve to a route, carry layout context, and behave like a canonical site surface.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_POST_DESC: Start from a publishable entry that expects scheduling, taxonomy, and discoverability over time.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_POST_USE_CASE: it will join a stream of entries, be categorized, and benefit from publishing cadence.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_REUSABLE_BLOCK_: Start from a reusable fragment you expect to place across multiple surfaces.
the same content needs to stay portable, shared, and optionally localized.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_EMAIL_TEMPLATE_: Start from a draft that is meant to ship as a reusable communication artifact.
it should stay localizable and ready for publishing without becoming page-like.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_TAXONOMY_ITEM_D: Start from a classification object that helps organize other content.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_TAXONOMY_ITEM_U: the content should behave like a controlled category, tag, or other organizing label.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_BLANK_DESC: Start from neutral clay and assemble the responsibilities one pack at a time.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PRESET_BLANK_USE_CASE: you know the draft should stay open-ended or evolve without a familiar preset boundary.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_CAPABILITY_PACKS_DESC: These are the canonical structure. Toggle the responsibilities this content should carry into the editor.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_ROUTABLE_DESC: Give the content a public-facing route or path responsibility.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_PUBLISHABLE_DESC: Let the content move through draft and publish lifecycle states.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_SEO_DESC: Carry metadata and search presentation concerns alongside the draft.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_LAYOUT_BOUND_DESC: Bind the content to a larger layout or site composition context.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_LOCALIZED_DESC: Author and evolve this content with locale-sensitive intent.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_REUSABLE_DESC: Keep the draft portable so it can be inserted or referenced in multiple places.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_TAXONOMY_DESC: Let the content behave as an organizing or classification surface.
CONTENT_BOOTSTRAP_PACK_SCHEDULABLE_DESC: Prepare the content for time-based release or timed state transitions.
